SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct,
  MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders_non_cancelled,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_with_test_article,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_store999,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) AS orders_no_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = l.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = l.store_key
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(x.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01') AS utc_date_count
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
